WORKFLOW GUIDE
widgets_values:
FINAL KURVA MAKER · KREA 2 · SCENE INSPIRATION + ALEX IDENTITY

CONTROL PANEL
1. Optionally upload one scene inspiration and crop it to 4:5.
2. Select the Alex identity angle closest to the desired head angle.
3. Leave OPTIONAL TWEAKS empty for an automatic related-but-new photograph, or enter only extra changes you want.
4. Run and inspect the generated/reference slider.

AUTOMATIC REFERENCE BEHAVIOR
The uploaded scene is analyzed for environment, approximate pose, camera behavior, imperfect phone lighting, exposure and color. A 32 × 40 abstract palette/light map also reaches Krea at low strength; this retains broad color and illumination while destroying all usable face, hair and clothing identity. The workflow invents a related location and ignores every source person.

IDENTITY
The selected Alex portrait is the only visual conditioning image. Alex is always the single visible person unless OPTIONAL TWEAKS explicitly asks for others. Her pale blue eyes, fair lightly freckled skin and long straight light golden-blonde centre-parted hair are reinforced in the compiled prompt. Scene-source faces, hair, eyewear and clothing never define her.

OUTPUT
FameGrid and Realism style LoRAs plus Color Finish are off by default to avoid polished commercial lighting; enable them in Advanced Settings only when wanted. Native generation is 1280 × 1600. A separate 1080 × 1350 Instagram delivery copy is saved after the FameGrid colour finish.

widgets_values_named.text:
FINAL KURVA MAKER · KREA 2 · SCENE INSPIRATION + ALEX IDENTITY

CONTROL PANEL
1. Optionally upload one scene inspiration and crop it to 4:5.
2. Select the Alex identity angle closest to the desired head angle.
3. Leave OPTIONAL TWEAKS empty for an automatic related-but-new photograph, or enter only extra changes you want.
4. Run and inspect the generated/reference slider.

AUTOMATIC REFERENCE BEHAVIOR
The scene image supplies visual language: location category, camera feel, atmosphere, lighting, palette, materials, depth of field and broad compositional energy. It is never treated as a background to trace. The workflow automatically invents a distinct plausible view of the same kind of place, varies the viewpoint, layout, objects and incidental people, and never copies background faces, signage or unique identifying details.

IDENTITY
Image 2 is the sole identity authority. The visible three-image Alex bank lets you select one angle while the model receives exactly one face reference, preventing twins and collages. The experimental Alex Krea2 LoRA is not used.

OUTPUT
Native generation is 1280 × 1600. A separate 1080 × 1350 Instagram delivery copy is saved after the FameGrid colour finish.

1 · Extract pose, phone lighting, color and scene · Qwen3-VL
widgets_values:
Analyze this photograph as inspiration for a new image of a different person. Output one compact production brief with these labeled clauses in prose, no markdown: POSE, FRAMING, CAMERA, LIGHTING/EXPOSURE, COLOR, SETTING, CLOTHING CATEGORY.

POSE must be precise enough to recreate approximately: seated or standing; torso direction and lean; head turn, tilt and gaze; shoulder and hip rotation; weight distribution; visible arm angles; elbow bends; exact hand placement; leg positions; and expression category. Describe only geometry, never the source person's body proportions or identity.

LIGHTING/EXPOSURE and COLOR must describe the pixels as they actually look, including imperfections rather than improving them: source direction, direct on-camera phone-flash appearance when the foreground is abruptly bright against a dark background, uneven exposure, blown highlights, crushed shadows, white-balance cast, saturation, contrast, phone HDR halos, sensor noise, sharpening, compression, motion blur and depth of field. State which visible defects and color relationships must be preserved. Do not replace imperfect phone lighting with studio, beauty, cinematic or editorial lighting.

Describe the environment's high-level style, materials and spatial organization, but request a newly invented related location rather than an exact copy. Ignore the source person's face, hair, eyes, skin, age, body proportions, eyewear, headwear and identity. Do not request background people. End with exactly one visible adult woman, no human reflections, and a full-bleed 4:5 rectilinear phone photograph.

widgets_values_named.custom_prompt: Analyze the supplied photograph as visual inspiration for a new Krea 2 scene, not as a reconstruction target. Output only a concise English inspiration brief with no heading. Extract the high-level photographic and design language: location category, camera-height family, lens feel, framing energy, perspective style, atmosphere, time of day, lighting quality and direction, palette and color contrast, materials and textures, spatial density, depth layers, depth of field, and the broad pose and clothing category of the main subject. Describe what makes the setting feel coherent while explicitly allowing a different viewpoint and a newly invented layout. Do not inventory or preserve exact furniture placement, unique objects, signage, logos, text, architectural arrangement, or background people's faces, identities, clothing, or positions. Treat background people only as anonymous optional ambience that must be regenerated as different individuals. Do not use the original foreground person's face, hair, eyes, skin, or age as identity requirements; Image 2 supplies the authoritative identity. End by requesting one plausible related-but-distinct Instagram photograph with coherent anatomy, no duplicate main subject, no copied bystanders, no borders, text, logo, or watermark.

nodes.title: Automatic reference mode · related scene, never a copy
widgets_values:
AUTOMATIC REFERENCE-INSPIRATION MODE: The uploaded scene supplies environment, approximate pose, framing, consumer-phone lighting, exposure behavior, palette and photographic defects. It is not a person-identity reference or a background plate. Recreate the analyzed pose approximately using Alex: preserve body orientation, seated/standing state, head direction, gaze, limb angles, hand placement and weight distribution unless OPTIONAL TWEAKS overrides them. Preserve the observed color relationships, white-balance cast, uneven illumination, flash appearance, clipped highlights, deep shadows, phone HDR, noise, sharpening, compression and depth of field instead of beautifying them. Invent a related but distinct setting with a different exact layout and objects.

Ignore every source person, including foreground identity, bystanders and reflections. Never transfer the source face, body traits, hair, eye color, skin, clothing details, eyewear, headwear, accessories or identity. The selected Alex portrait is the sole identity authority. Alex is a fictional adult woman with pale clear blue eyes, fair lightly freckled skin, a softly angular oval face, straight medium brows, a narrow straight nose, naturally shaped pink lips, and long straight light golden-blonde center-parted hair. Her eyes remain visible and blue; no eyewear or headwear unless explicitly requested.

The result contains exactly one visible human unless OPTIONAL TWEAKS explicitly requests more. Produce an ordinary spontaneous phone photograph, not a professionally lit portrait or advertisement. No studio key/fill/rim lighting, beauty lighting, perfect symmetry, airbrushed skin, uniformly controlled exposure, background people, human reflections, twins, fisheye, black corners, border, text, logo or watermark. OPTIONAL TWEAKS may be empty.

widgets_values_named.string_b: AUTOMATIC REFERENCE-INSPIRATION MODE: Image 1 is visual inspiration, never a background plate or exact reconstruction target. Reuse its high-level location category, photographic character, atmosphere, palette, lighting logic, materials, depth of field, and broad compositional energy, then create a clearly distinct but believable photograph: shift the viewpoint, rebuild the layout, rearrange or replace objects, vary architectural details, and use a different natural moment. It should feel like another view in the same venue or a different venue with the same design language. Do not copy signage, logos, text, distinctive objects, or any background person's face, identity, clothing, pose, or location; omit bystanders or invent different anonymous people. Image 2 is the sole authoritative identity reference for the only main foreground adult woman. Preserve Image 2's facial geometry, eyes, eyebrows, nose, lips, jawline, skin features, hair, and apparent age. Never retain or blend Image 1's foreground identity. Never duplicate, clone, mirror, or create twins. Produce a full-bleed vertical 4:5 rectilinear Instagram photograph without fisheye, black corners, borders, text, logo, or watermark. The OPTIONAL TWEAKS field may be empty; if it is empty, invent a natural related scene without requiring user instructions.
